official.deadline_note: No separate institutional deadline is published; the call states results will be announced at the end of November 2026 and the funded period begins 2 November 2026
official.status_note: The convocatoria states that the deadline for presenting projects is 16 October 2026 and that results will be made known at the end of November 2026
official.funding_period: total award for the full grant period (up to 10 months)
benefits: Individual research grant of S/. 10 000 (diez mil soles)
Group research grant of S/. 20 000 (veinte mil soles)
Maximum duration of ten months, set between 2 November 2026 and 3 September 2027
The economic support finances the fees (honorarios) of the lead researcher and of the research assistant

Payment in two instalments: 50% after signature of the award contract and 50% after publication of the results in a Scopus or Web of Science indexed journal or in an academic-press book, with explicit affiliation to the Instituto Riva-Aguero
Projects may count on another source of funding, from PUCP or external, in cash or in documentary sources for the research, which must be mentioned in the project submission
PUCP community members are paid through the payroll (boleta de remuneraciones); external members receive the amount through recibo por honorarios
eligibility: Ordinary members of the Instituto Riva-Aguero

Associate members of the Instituto Riva-Aguero who hold a doctorate, are contracted PUCP teaching staff with dedication TPA, TPC or TC, and have taught at least one course worth a minimum of two credits in the last four regular semesters including the semesters of this call (2025-1, 2025-2, 2026-1 and 2026-2)

Affiliated and honorary members of the Instituto Riva-Aguero who hold a doctorate and are part of a research group, with no academic activity, article or research pending delivery to the Institute at the time of application
Group modality: all study and research groups registered and approved by the Institute council up to the closing date of the call
The lead researcher (individual modality) or the group (group modality) must have a Pontificia Universidad Catolica del Peru undergraduate student as project assistant
requirements: Present an original research project inscribed in one of the Institute's five research lines

Follow the prescribed project format: title, rationale of the proposed topic, state of the question, hypothesis, objectives, methodology, research outline, activity schedule, bibliography, budget, and a brief updated curriculum vitae of all participants
Submit through the Instituto Riva-Aguero online form for the chosen modality (one form for the individual grant, one for the group grant)
Sign the grant award contracts established with the Instituto Riva-Aguero
Present a progress report of the project within three months of its start, with 31 January 2027 as the maximum date
Deliver the article for publication in an indexed journal no later than 31 December 2027, with explicit affiliation to the Instituto Riva-Aguero in the publication
For the group modality, the group coordinator signs the subvention contracts and administers the funds granted by the grant
documents: Online form completed with the documentation for the chosen modality (individual or group), linked in section 5 of the convocatoria
Brief updated curriculum vitae of all participants in the project (part of the prescribed project format)
Budget for the project (presupuesto, part of the prescribed project format)
For the group modality, the group online form with the required documentation
coverage: The individual support of S/. 10 000 finances the fees (honorarios) of the lead researcher and of the research assistant
The group support of S/. 20 000 is administered by the group coordinator under the subvention contract
Two instalments of 50%: the first after signature of the contract, the second after publication of the results in a Scopus or Web of Science indexed journal or an academic-press book
Amounts paid to members of the PUCP community are remuneration subject to pension contributions and to fifth-category income tax, that is, subject to the deductions imposed by law
Additional PUCP or external financing may be combined with the grant and must be declared in the project submission
application_method: Complete the online form published by the Instituto Riva-Aguero with the full project documentation - separate forms exist for the individual and the group modality, both linked in section 5 of the convocatoria (https://forms.gle/xVYLHBFwJGRDv6dE8 and https://forms.gle/U43bj4LurapMfQTA9)

Selection is carried out by a committee made up of the director or the research coordinator of the Institute, a representative of the PUCP Vice-Rectorate of Research, and a member of the Instituto Riva-Aguero; the committee may call on other members of the Institute's governing council and national or international experts
Queries about the call go to evelyn.sotomayor@pucp.pe
official.application_route: Fill in the Instituto Riva-Aguero online form for the individual or group modality with the complete project dossier before the 16 October 2026 deadline
official.citizenship_residency: Eligibility is by Instituto Riva-Aguero membership category rather than nationality: ordinary members; associate members with a doctorate who are contracted PUCP teaching staff (TPA, TPC or TC); affiliated or honorary members with a doctorate belonging to a research group; and, for the group modality, research groups registered and approved by the Institute council
official.subject_or_agency_requirement: Project topics must be inscribed in one of the Institute's five research lines: (1) history of Peru, Latin America and transatlantic history, 16th-21st centuries; (2) state, politics, processes and social actors, 16th-21st centuries; (3) literature, art, cinema and other cultural practices; (4) tangible and intangible heritage; (5) philosophy, science and education in Peru and its relations with Latin America and Europe, 16th-21st centuries
official.research_requirement: An original research project led by a principal investigator who is responsible as director of their own project (individual modality) or directed by the group coordinator (group modality), with a PUCP undergraduate student as project assistant
official.duration: Maximum ten months, established between 2 November 2026 and 3 September 2027
official.description: The Directorate of the Instituto Riva-Aguero of the Pontificia Universidad Catolica del Peru announces its 2027 call for research support grants: an individual research grant of S/. 10 000 and a group research grant of S/. 20 000, each with a maximum duration of ten months between 2 November 2026 and 3 September 2027, financing the fees of the lead researcher and the research assistant. Projects must be inscribed in one of the Institute's five research lines and winners commit to publishing the results in a Scopus or Web of Science indexed journal or an academic-press book, with explicit affiliation to the Instituto Riva-Aguero.
official.region: Peru (Pontificia Universidad Catolica del Peru, Lima)
official.program_type: Research support grant (beca de apoyo a la investigacion) in individual and group modalities

applicant_utility.summary: This is an internal research grant for members of the Instituto Riva-Aguero, not an open scholarship: you must already fit one of the call's membership categories, or belong to a council-registered research group if you apply as a group. The S/. 10 000 individual award is paid as fees for you and a PUCP undergraduate assistant, half on contract signature and half only after a Scopus/Web of Science article or academic-press book is published with IRA affiliation, so plan cash flow around that second, publication-contingent payment. Submissions close 16 October 2026, results arrive at the end of November, and the funded window is short: up to ten months, 2 November 2026 to 3 September 2027.
applicant_utility.best_fit: Doctoral members of the Instituto Riva-Aguero, or its registered research groups, working on Peruvian and Latin American history, politics and society, culture, heritage or philosophy and education, who can host a PUCP undergraduate assistant.
application_readiness_checklist: Confirm which membership route you qualify under before drafting: ordinary member; doctoral associate member with a TPA/TPC/TC contract and at least one two-credit course taught across 2025-1, 2025-2, 2026-1 and 2026-2; or doctoral affiliated/honorary member of a research group with nothing pending to the Institute
Secure a PUCP undergraduate student as project assistant in advance - the call makes this indispensable in both modalities

Write the project in the exact prescribed order: title, rationale, state of the question, hypothesis, objectives, methodology, research outline, schedule, bibliography, budget and brief updated CVs of all participants
Build the budget so that the S/. 10 000 (or S/. 20 000 for groups) realistically covers your and the assistant's fees for up to ten months
Clear any academic activity, article or research you owe the Institute before applying if you are an affiliated or honorary member
Submit through the correct online form for your modality before 16 October 2026 and keep proof; questions go to evelyn.sotomayor@pucp.pe
common_rejection_risks: A topic that cannot be clearly inscribed in one of the Institute's five research lines
No PUCP undergraduate assistant, or an assistant from outside PUCP
Affiliated or honorary applicants who still owe the Institute a pending activity, article or research at the time of application
Associate-member applicants without a two-credit course taught in the four named semesters
A timeline that cannot be executed within the ten-month window from 2 November 2026
Defaulting on the progress report due by 31 January 2027, which forces return of the first payment and blocks entry to future Institute calls
applicant_utility.estimated_uncovered_costs: The grant is earmarked for the fees of the lead researcher and the student assistant; the call publishes no allowance for travel, field costs, materials, equipment or publication fees, and amounts paid to PUCP members reach the recipient net of pension contributions and fifth-category income tax, so other research and personal costs must be covered from complementary or personal funds.
document_audit: The brief updated CV must cover every participant in the project, not only the lead
The project must include all prescribed parts in order; a missing bibliography or schedule can sink an otherwise strong dossier
The individual and group online forms are separate - submitting through the wrong one risks non-admission
Group applications: the coordinator signs the subvention contracts and administers the money, so verify the group is registered and approved by the Institute council before the closing date
Keep the contract-signature and payment paperwork, since the second instalment depends on documented indexed publication
alerts: The deadline is 16 October 2026 and results are only announced at the end of November 2026, while the funded period starts on 2 November 2026 - do not assume pre-award work is covered
The second 50% is released only against indexed publication (or an official letter that the article is in press), and the publication must explicitly state affiliation to the Instituto Riva-Aguero

The Institute retains the right to publish the research for two years from delivery of the publishable document; afterwards the author may publish freely but must note that the Instituto Riva-Aguero financed it
Failure to deliver the progress report by 31 January 2027 means returning the first payment and being barred from both future individual and group calls
Amounts paid to PUCP community members are remuneration subject to pension contributions and fifth-category income tax deductions
applicant_utility.submission_workflow: Fill the modality-specific online form with the full dossier, the committee (Institute director or research coordinator, a Vice-Rectorate of Research representative and an Institute member, plus optional experts) evaluates, results are announced at the end of November 2026, winners sign the award contract and receive the first 50%, then deliver the progress report by 31 January 2027 and the publishable article by 31 December 2027 to unlock the second 50%.
